claims.statement: Bill Davis was an old opponent of Tom Allen; the article gives no date or result for that bout.
claims.excerpt: boxed Bill Davis, an oid opponent of Tom Allen.

fights.excerpt: boxed Bill Davis, an oid opponent of Tom Allen.
fights.notes: Allen appears only as Davis's earlier opponent; no details given. Miller's own bout with Davis (January 1875, printed ISTS) is not Allen's.

notes: Article is about William Miller and Theobald Bauer. Allen appears only in the record of Miller's bout with Bill Davis.
